info.title: A command line and MCP tool for Lumoin.Veridical
info.description: A command line and Model Context Protocol (MCP) tool for Lumoin.Veridical: BLAKE3 hashing, platform/backend information, and a self-test that runs known-answer conformance vectors (field arithmetic, the SIMD batch multiply, and hashing). The same operations are exposed as MCP tools.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: A command line and MCP tool for Lumoin.Veridical.

commands.name: hash
commands.description: Compute the BLAKE3-256 hash of an input.

options.name: --hex
options.description: Interpret the input as a hex-encoded byte string.

arguments.name: INPUT
arguments.description: The input to hash (UTF-8 text, or hex with --hex).

commands.name: prove
commands.description: Prove a supply-chain predicate bundle from local data; writes the proof artifact JSON to standard output.

arguments.name: REQUEST_FILE
arguments.description: Path to the prove-request JSON, or - for standard input.

commands.name: selftest
commands.description: Run the known-answer conformance vectors (exit non-zero on failure).

commands.name: verify
commands.description: Verify a proof artifact and report the statement it proves (exit non-zero when it does not verify).

arguments.name: ARTIFACT_FILE
arguments.description: Path to the proof artifact JSON, or - for standard input.
